values.en: A constructor declaration stores its name and complete dependent-function type. Leading Π-binders describe constructor arguments; after those binders are removed, the result must be an application of the inductive family being declared.
values.zh-CN: 构造子声明保存其名称与完整的依赖函数类型。开头的 Π-绑定子描述构造参数；去掉这些绑定子后，结果必须是当前所声明归纳类型族的一个应用。
